entries.title: Kimi Code works as a subscription
entries.body: Add your Kimi Code plan in Settings, Intelligence, with Kimi Code: sign in with a code in your browser or paste a Kimi Code key. Its row shows how much of the plan's session, weekly and monthly allowance is left, and the first mate starts with k3 for high work and kimi-for-coding for medium work. A Kimi Code account you added before loads again, and asks you to sign in again once its sign-in has lapsed.

picture.alt: Settings, Intelligence, with a Kimi Code account named Personal on the Allegretto plan showing session 70%, weekly 90% and monthly 95% left, above the Add account chips that now include Kimi Code.
